configuration_boundary.morphology: bimanual dual-arm, 16 joint DoF; each arm has waist, shoulder, elbow, forearm_roll, wrist_angle, wrist_rotate, and two coupled finger joints
configuration_boundary.joint_unit: rad for hinge joints; m for finger slide joints
configuration_boundary.model_range_facts: Finger physical rail range is 0..0.041 m and software control range is 0.002..0.037 m; arm range classes are declared in the Menagerie MJCF.

source_registry.facts: ALOHA 2 overview, duplicated left/right ViperX-derived kinematic tree, gripper equality coupling, sites, joint classes, ranges, and actuator names.
ALOHA 2 bimanual hardware identity and publication provenance.

source_status: PUBLIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; MJCF and assets intentionally not vendored in this preparation package

tasks.description: Move the left ALOHA gripper reference to the specified 3-D target and hold.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Single-arm Cartesian reach using the left chain; target is anchored to a declared scene body.
tasks.criterion_summary: Left gripper target error is at most 30 mm for 0.5 s; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Move the right ALOHA gripper reference to the specified 3-D target and hold.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Right-arm counterpart of A01; kept as a separate task to expose both arm paths.
tasks.criterion_summary: Right gripper target error is at most 30 mm for 0.5 s; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Move both ALOHA gripper references to the specified paired targets and hold them together.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Minimal synchronized two-arm primitive without object interaction.
tasks.criterion_summary: Both gripper target errors are at most 40 mm for 0.5 s; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Open and close both ALOHA grippers once, with the two finger pairs moving together.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Minimal dual-hand actuation check using the equality-coupled finger joints.
tasks.criterion_summary: Each gripper shows at least 10 mrad of opening and closing excursion; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Move both ALOHA gripper references by the specified small Cartesian offset, hold, and return.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Reusable G2-style offset-and-return effect applied to both arms.
tasks.criterion_summary: Each offset and return error is at most 40 mm; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.
